card.name: Inside all-caps penicillin warning text
card.fires_on: Word endings and hyphens inside ALL-CAPS label warnings, mostly the penicillin allergy caution. It fires on pieces like OCCUR-S, PENICILLIN-, CONCERN-ING and CAFFE-INE.

modes.label: Penicillin-sensitive caution
modes.description: The ending or hyphen in PENICILLIN-SENSITIVE patients within an all-caps allergy warning.
modes.example: IF THIS PRODUCT IS TO BE GIVEN TO PENICILLIN<<->>SENSITIVE PATIENTS, CAUTION

modes.label: Allergic reaction wording
modes.description: The ending of OCCURS or CONCERNING in capitalized hypersensitivity warnings.
modes.example: IF AN ALLERGIC REACTION OCCUR<<S>>, BICILLIN C-R SHOULD

modes.label: Caffeine dose note
modes.description: The ending of CAFFEINE in a capitalized note about caffeine base versus citrate.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the later pieces of words in capital-letter warning text, especially about penicillin allergy.
